mapper.select:
select id, cid , api_code , field_name as fieldName , field_value as fieldValue , field_desc as fieldDesc , is_del as isDel , DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime , DATE_FORMAT(update_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime from b_variable_dic vd
and vd.cid like CONCAT('%',#{cid},'%')
and vd.api_code like CONCAT('%',#{apiCode},'%')
order by vd.update_time desc, vd.create_time desc
